The set has only three small outcome branches: a thumb rest (s000014, s000028, s000017, s000034), a reshaped bowl (s000058, s000036, s000053, s000021, s000048, s000057), or a smoothed dent with the original cup and handle (s000023, s000002). Most wording and events are nearly identical, so these few samples show little variation within the set.
